Pianist Denny Zeitlin was born in Chicago on April 10, 1938. He has gained critical acclaim as a composer and for his recordings that range from solo piano to electronic music. A long time San Francisco resident, Dr. Zeitlin currently maintains a thriving career as a psychotherapist, composer and pianist.
He was interviewed in San Francisco, California on August 8, 2002 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are in San Francisco filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. It’s a real pleasure to be talking with Dr. Denny Zeitlin this afternoon.
Thanks for fitting us into your — you probably have a busy schedule.
